danger_formalization.robot_task: Cook kale by retrieving it from the refrigerator, adding olive oil and salt, and heating it in the oven.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot spills hot olive oil while pouring it into the saucepot, causing a slippery surface and potential burns.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Human slips on the oil spill or suffers burns from contact with hot oil.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Pour olive oil from the bottle into the saucepot inaccurately, leading to spillage.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Robot should use a controlled pouring motion with sensors to detect spillage and stop immediately if overflow is detected, then clean the spill before proceeding.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has basic manipulation capabilities to handle bottles and pots, but may lack precision in fluid handling tasks.
